scripts.dev: npm run sync-ports && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.142 preview
scripts.check: npm run sync-ports && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.142 check
scripts.render: npm run render:desktop && npm run render:mobile
scripts.render:desktop: npm run sync-ports && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.142 render -o renders/hero-desktop.mp4 --quality delivery
scripts.render:mobile: npm run sync-ports && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.142 render -c compositions/mobile.html -o renders/hero-mobile.mp4 --quality delivery
